thread:
mira: kicking off discussion: proposal for a cost-aware, compliance-aware routing policy that minimizes slice permutations. Goal: support 3 customer-facing tiers + a compliance lane without blowing up control-plane complexity. short version: define orthogonal dimensions (tier, region_affinity, compliance), then instantiate routing at request-time by composing rules rather than pre-creating every slice permutation. thoughts?

alex: love the composition idea. avoids combinatorial slice surface. main risk: runtime policy evaluation latency and config explosion in policy store. we need a compact representation.

sana: from product/customer side: ask matrix we got from sales: finance customers want region PIN + model PIN + dedicated capacity. startups want predictable latency (p95) but flexible region. Compliance lane must be possible on Private deployments too.

otto: ops point: evictions + cross-band fallback are tricky. if we compose at request-time we need deterministic tie-breakers so requests for same tenant go to same slice unless eviction happens. propose a stable-hash + affinity score approach.

jamie: runtime constraints: KV cache isolation vs shared cache. if we do logical composition (tier+region) but actual runtime pools are consolidated, we must simulate cache hit-rate regressions. ask: can we offer "hot-cache credits" per tenant as a priced add-on?

vik: proposing gating criteria for roadmap prioritization:
- Gate A (research): sims for cache impact + policy-eval latency (2 weeks)
- Gate B (pilot): 2 paid gold customers (min $X/mo each) + 5 silver tenants for mixed workload (1 month run)
- Gate C (launch): latency targets met + 99.95% regional availability for gold + cost model within 15% of projection

mira: nice. also: product asks for rollout control: API-level flags to opt tenants into tier/compliance plus UI in Console to request region pin. must be easy for CS to change temporarily.

alex: initial policy grammar sketch (compact):
```yaml
policy_version: 2026-03-01
rules:
  - match: tenant.annotations.tier == "gold"
    action: {affinity: regional_strict, resources: dedicated_pool, fallback: silver}
  - match: tenant.annotations.compliance == "pci"
    action: {region_pin: eu-west-1, model_pin: gptx-200, force_isolation: true}
  - match: otherwise
    action: {affinity: soft, resources: shared_pool}
```

sana: small ask: product wants "migration grace" for tenants when moving tiers (avoid double billing + cold cache p99 spikes). add migration window and warm-up tokens.

otto: runbook sketch for eviction/fallback: `mark_slice_readonly(S); drain_inflight(120s); redirect_new_requests(target=fallback); if p95_latency(target) > threshold -> scale_out(target)` plus alert to oncall and CS.

jamie: metrics to collect during pilots: p50/p95/p99 per-tenant, cache hit-rate (global + per-slice), token cost-per-100k, rollout-failures, cold-start rates after migration. log sample: `tenant_id, tier, region, slice_id, cache_hit, latency_ms, tokens`

vik: dev rough timeline: control-plane policy engine + compact grammar = 2 sprints; console + api flags + cs tools = 1 sprint; runtime pooling changes + eviction automation = 3 sprints; pilot + metrics = 2 sprints. total ~8 sprints with parallel work.

mira: prioritization ask: if sales lines up 2 gold customers we accelerate. otherwise push to Q1 next year. action items: @vik run policy-eval latency proto, @jamie run cache sim with 50/30/20 traffic split, @sana consolidate customer ask doc + pricing ask, @alex build minimal policy grammar RFC. scheduling note: follow-up sync Wed 11am for 30m.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident channel created for pilot: #pilot-gold-evictions

mira: thanks team :raised_hands:
